recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-7731; use the existing FHIR-32960 reconciliation as the current source authority for the MedicationAdministration/Immunization vaccine boundary.
issue_request: FHIR-7731 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy DSTU1 clarification asking to replace MedicationAdministration text that excluded vaccines with wording that covers medication administration and directs vaccine treatment to Immunization, with Grahame's comment suggesting explicit mention of medications and vaccines.
initial_application: Git commit 5555750a4cce94cd357c3178441d043caa13f1ca explicitly listed #7731 and #7732 and changed the active MedicationAdministration introduction from excluding vaccines to saying it covered all medications and vaccines while referring to Immunization Resource/Profile for vaccines.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration and Immunization are active resources in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-25538 later retained the older all-medications-and-vaccines wording during a broader MedicationAdministration definition review. FHIR-32960 later clarified the same boundary, removing the literal all-medications-and-vaccines phrasing and aligning MedicationAdministration and Immunization guidance; that source-changing reconciliation is already on the combined branch as b7214bc5256739e402b4118bf12c9492f9291cbd. FHIR-7732, applied in the same 2015 commit, is already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current MedicationAdministration Scope and Usage no longer excludes vaccines and directs vaccine treatment to Immunization; the boundary text, matched on the Immunization page, permits MedicationAdministration for vaccination workflow or other reasons only with an equivalent Immunization instance. Reinstating the literal 2015 'and vaccines' phrase would conflict with later approved FHIR-32960 guidance.
